request.query: Roth auxiliary polynomial index parameter gamma m minus lambda divided by two

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux'
items.type: ∀ (n d : ℕ), ↑(d ^ n) / ↑(n * d ^ 2) ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ n → ↑d ^ (n - 2) / ↑n ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Complex.GammaAux_recurrence1
items.type: ∀ (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ), -s.re < ↑n → Complex.GammaAux n s = Complex.GammaAux n (s + 1) / s

items.name: rothNumberNat_add_le
items.type: ∀ (M N : ℕ), rothNumberNat (M + N) ≤ rothNumberNat M + rothNumberNat N
